summary:
A new isolated issue affected bcftools_concat across 6 tests with a "History not found" error, likely pointing to a data staging or history context lookup problem during test setup. Persistent issues remain stable, including the long-standing shared infrastructure failure affecting input data across 6 tools alongside several continuing tool-specific errors. Ten issues recovered in this run, clearing up errors across multiple tools.

The absence of database connection-pool errors in the server logs suggests the server was keeping up during this run, making general server overload an unlikely explanation. Furthermore, because this exact error signature was first recorded in an August run, it points toward a recurring intermittent state issue rather than a brand new regression.
